consequence_route_snapshots.first_line: They wrote the names down. In the courtyard.
consequence_route_snapshots.caption: A covered clinic courtyard became a meeting point during the storm. The register assembled there later helped families find their relatives. These pages preserve some of their names.
consequence_route_snapshots.journal: A record of the storm-night shelter is on display in the present. Mother says it has been here for years. I remember helping make it possible. I still don't know what started the war.

consequence_route_snapshots.caption: A covered clinic courtyard became a meeting point during the storm. The register assembled there later helped families find their relatives. These pages preserve some of their names.
consequence_route_snapshots.journal: The town remembers a different version of the storm. I remember the empty display and what I did in the past. Mother remembers the new record being here for years. I can change something. I still don't know what started the war.

consequence_route_snapshots.first_line: The departure list. They managed to record everyone waiting there.
consequence_route_snapshots.caption: The repaired waiting shelter brought departing families together during the storm. The passenger list assembled there later helped relatives trace where they had gone.
consequence_route_snapshots.journal: A record of the storm-night shelter is on display in the present. Mother says it has been here for years. I remember helping make it possible. I still don't know what started the war.
